# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Runtime performance and rendering**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves browser WebGPU packaging, Android texture rendering, and managed graphics and text-shaping performance. Browser WebGPU apps can link against the packaged native archive without compiling C++ support themselves. Android texture rendering now follows display refresh, while image copying and HarfBuzz text shaping avoid unnecessary managed and native allocations.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Platform

- **Browser WebGPU support is packaged with the native archive** — The emdawnwebgpu implementation is included in libSkiaSharp.a, so browser applications can link WebGPU support without separately compiling its C++ source. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))

## Bug Fixes

- **Android texture rendering follows the display clock** — Continuous Android GL texture rendering is paced by display refresh rather than buffer-swap throughput, reducing unnecessary paint callbacks while preserving explicit render requests and lifecycle behavior. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Front-buffered managed streams no longer retain data unnecessarily** — Corrects stream retention so front-buffered managed streams can release data when it is no longer needed. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))

## API Surface

- **Image copying and text shaping reduce temporary allocations** — Managed pixel buffers that can be copied directly avoid an intermediate SKData instance, while HarfBuzz UTF-32 input and feature-string formatting reuse storage without changing existing decoding behavior. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))
